front.title: IS-IS and OSPF Extensions for Inter-AS Multi-Topology Binding

abstract.t:
[RFC5120] and [RFC4915] define Multi-Topology (MT) routing for IS-IS and OSPF, respectively. When a topology-specific path crosses an AS boundary, a topology in one AS may need to be connected to a topology identified by a different MT-ID in the adjacent AS.
Existing inter-AS Traffic Engineering extensions do not advertise this relationship.
This document defines extensions to IS-IS and OSPF to advertise the binding between local and remote MT-IDs associated with an inter-AS link.
